title: diskio_activity row
description: Provisional. One row per one second bin, process, volume, directory, extension, disk and operation from the aggregate the diskio-trace collector makes on the PC from a kernel trace (DiskIo Read and Write, PageFault_HardFault, FileIo_Name, Process and Thread events) and keeps as raw/diskio_aggregate/aggregate.jsonl; the trace itself never leaves the PC. bin_start_s counts whole seconds from the trace header's StartTime (etw_qpc_relative). Directories keep fixed Windows roots and one level below them in clear, <profile> for the user folder, and dir-<12 hex> per run salted pseudonyms below that; file names are never kept, and an extension is kept only from the collector's fixed list of file classes (other otherwise). Decoder: scripts/decode_diskio.py.

bin_start_s.description: Start of the one second bin, in whole seconds since the trace header's StartTime.

process_id.description: The process of the issuing thread (DiskIo IssuingThreadId, PageFault_HardFault TThreadId) from the trace's own Thread events; null when the trace never names the thread.

process_image.description: ImageFileName of the process, or image-<12 hex> when the name is outside the readable pattern; null without a Process event.

directory.description: The directory of the file, without the volume and the file name; null for path_class unnamed and collector.

disk_number.description: DiskIo DiskNumber; null for hard_fault rows (the event carries no disk).

transferred_bytes.description: Sum of DiskIo TransferSize, or of PageFault_HardFault ByteCount for hard_fault rows.

paging_operations.description: Disk requests whose IrpFlags carry IRP_PAGING_IO (0x2, the wdm.h value, not stated on Microsoft Learn; collectors/windows/README.md verification list); null for hard_fault rows.

irp_flags_operations.description: Disk requests per verbatim IrpFlags value, as the collector counted them.

response_time_sum_us.description: Sum of HighResResponseTime over the row's disk requests, converted with the header's PerfFreq; null for hard_fault rows.
